Books

Business & Marketing

Customer Data Platforms

Wiley · 2020

#1 Amazon Best Seller in Business Marketing

Marketers face a stark dilemma: customers demand deep personalization, but are increasingly wary of sharing personal data. Customer Data Platforms offers a solution — a comprehensive guide to capturing, unifying, activating, and analyzing customer data while respecting privacy.

This book covers:

  • Understanding the problems of managing customer data
  • What CDPs do (and don't do)
  • Building a safe, compliant first-party data asset
  • Leveraging AI and machine learning for personalization
  • Orchestrating modern customer journeys in real-time

Data Driven

McGraw Hill · 2018
🏆 Axiom Silver Medal – Business Technology

The indispensable guide to data-powered marketing from the team behind the data management platform that helps fuel Salesforce.

Digital technology, social media, and e-commerce have radically changed how consumers access information and make purchases. Using cloud, mobile, social, IoT, and AI, we have more data about customers than ever before. Data-Driven shows how to harness that data to build lasting customer relationships.

  • The three principles for building a successful data strategy
  • The five sources of data-driven power
  • Seven forecasts for the future of marketing

"There has never been a more bewildering—or exciting—time to be a brand, and Chavez, O'Hara, and Vaidya are the smartest guides we've got." — Martin Kihn, VP Research, Gartner
